Monsoon season brings tips for home maintenance and comfort

As the monsoon season arrives, various Indian media outlets have published advice on managing common household issues. Tips focus on cleaning slippery moss from rooftops, preventing dampness and odors in clothes, and dealing with increased humidity and pests like lizards. Advice also covers maintaining indoor plants, keeping coolers efficient, and drying wet shoes. Some reports highlight the health benefits of consuming karonda during this season.
